name: Rpt_SalesmanSalesSummary
purpose: Net sales invoices grouped by salesperson for a date range.
sql: SELECT th.SalesPersonID, sp.Name AS SalesPersonName, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count, (SELECT SUM(td.Quantity * td.Price) FROM t.TransactionsHeaders th2 INNER JOIN t.TransactionsDetails td ON th2.CompanyID = td.CompanyID AND th2.TransactionTypeID = td.TransactionTypeID AND th2.TransactionYear = td.TransactionYear AND th2.TransactionNo = td.TransactionNo WHERE th2.SalesPersonID = th.SalesPersonID AND th2.TransactionTypeID = 1 AND ISNULL(th2.IsVoid, 0) = 0{date_filter_th2}{salesperson_filter_th2}) AS gross_amount FROM t.TransactionsHeaders th INNER JOIN t.SalesPersons sp ON sp.ID = th.SalesPersonID AND sp.CompanyID = th.CompanyID WHERE th.TransactionTypeID = 1 AND ISNULL(th.IsVoid, 0) = 0{date_filter}{salesperson_filter} GROUP BY th.SalesPersonID, sp.Name ORDER BY gross_amount DESC

name: Rpt_DailyReceiptsDetails
purpose: Receipt collection lines for a date range (TransactionDate / TransactionNo).
sql: SELECT r.TransactionDate, r.TransactionYear, r.TransactionNo, r.CustomerID, c.Name AS CustomerName, r.Amount, r.SalesPersonID FROM t.Receipts r LEFT JOIN t.Customers c ON c.ID = r.CustomerID AND c.CompanyID = r.CompanyID WHERE r.TransactionTypeID = 3{receipt_date_filter} ORDER BY r.TransactionDate DESC, r.TransactionNo

name: Rpt_CustomersSalesDetails
purpose: Invoice line detail by customer for sales invoices.
sql: SELECT th.CustomerID, c.Name AS CustomerName, th.TransactionDate, th.TransactionNo, td.ItemCode, td.Quantity, td.Price, td.Quantity * td.Price AS line_amount FROM t.TransactionsHeaders th INNER JOIN t.TransactionsDetails td ON th.CompanyID = td.CompanyID AND th.TransactionTypeID = td.TransactionTypeID AND th.TransactionYear = td.TransactionYear AND th.TransactionNo = td.TransactionNo LEFT JOIN t.Customers c ON c.ID = th.CustomerID AND c.CompanyID = th.CompanyID WHERE th.TransactionTypeID = 1 AND ISNULL(th.IsVoid, 0) = 0{date_filter}{customer_filter} ORDER BY th.TransactionDate DESC, th.TransactionNo

name: Rpt_ItemTransaction
purpose: Sales and return invoice lines for one item.
sql: SELECT th.TransactionDate, th.TransactionTypeID, th.TransactionNo, th.CustomerID, td.ItemCode, td.Quantity, td.Price FROM t.TransactionsHeaders th INNER JOIN t.TransactionsDetails td ON th.CompanyID = td.CompanyID AND th.TransactionTypeID = td.TransactionTypeID AND th.TransactionYear = td.TransactionYear AND th.TransactionNo = td.TransactionNo WHERE ISNULL(th.IsVoid, 0) = 0 AND th.TransactionTypeID IN (1, 2){date_filter}{item_filter} ORDER BY th.TransactionDate DESC

name: Rpt_CollectedReceipts
purpose: Receipt headers with customer and salesperson for a period.
sql: SELECT r.TransactionDate, r.TransactionYear, r.TransactionNo, r.CustomerID, c.Name AS CustomerName, r.SalesPersonID, sp.Name AS SalesPersonName, r.Amount FROM t.Receipts r LEFT JOIN t.Customers c ON c.ID = r.CustomerID AND c.CompanyID = r.CompanyID LEFT JOIN t.SalesPersons sp ON sp.ID = r.SalesPersonID AND sp.CompanyID = r.CompanyID WHERE r.TransactionTypeID = 3{receipt_date_filter} ORDER BY r.TransactionDate DESC, r.TransactionNo

name: Rpt_SalesAndOrders
purpose: Compare order count and sales invoice count by salesperson.
sql: SELECT sp.ID AS SalesPersonID, sp.Name AS SalesPersonName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t.OrdersHeaders oh WHERE oh.SalesPersonID = sp.ID{order_date_filter}) AS order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t.TransactionsHeaders th WHERE th.SalesPersonID = sp.ID AND th.TransactionTypeID = 1 AND ISNULL(th.IsVoid, 0) = 0{invoice_date_filter}) AS invoice_count FROM t.SalesPersons sp WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY invoice_count DESC

name: Rpt_ActiveAndInactiveCustomers
purpose: Customers with and without recent sales invoices.
sql: SELECT c.ID AS CustomerID, c.Name AS CustomerName, CASE WHEN MAX(th.TransactionDate) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS is_active, MAX(th.TransactionDate) AS last_sale_date FROM t.Customers c LEFT JOIN t.TransactionsHeaders th ON th.CustomerID = c.ID AND th.CompanyID = c.CompanyID AND th.TransactionTypeID = 1 AND ISNULL(th.IsVoid, 0) = 0{date_filter_on_th} GROUP BY c.ID, c.Name ORDER BY is_active DESC, last_sale_date DESC

name: Rpt_ItemsNotSold
purpose: Items with no sales invoice lines in the period.
sql: SELECT i.ItemCode, i.Name AS ItemName FROM t.Items i WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t.TransactionsHeaders th INNER JOIN t.TransactionsDetails td ON th.CompanyID = td.CompanyID AND th.TransactionTypeID = td.TransactionTypeID AND th.TransactionYear = td.TransactionYear AND th.TransactionNo = td.TransactionNo WHERE td.ItemCode = i.ItemCode AND td.CompanyID = i.CompanyID AND th.TransactionTypeID = 1 AND ISNULL(th.IsVoid, 0) = 0{date_filter_exists}) ORDER BY i.ItemCode

name: Rpt_Coverage
purpose: CFD RouteID assignment vs DeliveryRoute visit rows (CompNo, SalesmanNo, CustomerID, RouteDate).
sql: SELECT cfd.RouteID, COUNT(DISTINCT cfd.CustomerID) AS assigned_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT dr.CustomerID) AS visited_customers FROM t.CustomersFinancialDetails cfd LEFT JOIN t.DeliveryRoute dr ON dr.CustomerID = cfd.CustomerID AND dr.CompNo = cfd.CompanyID GROUP BY cfd.RouteID ORDER BY assigned_customers DESC

name: Rpt_CashSummary
purpose: Total receipts amount by TransactionDate for a period.
sql: SELECT CAST(r.TransactionDate AS date) AS receipt_day, COUNT(*) AS receipt_count, SUM(r.Amount) AS total_amount FROM t.Receipts r WHERE r.TransactionTypeID = 3{receipt_date_filter} GROUP BY CAST(r.TransactionDate AS date) ORDER BY receipt_day DESC
